notes: Baseline is actual, not appropriated: the fund sits outside the finance law and its own year-end accounts are the only stage printed. Charges 100,864,138,246.92 = grants 100,441,652,714.93 + external services 422,485,531.99; income 100,730,385,066.30, of which operator contributions 100,114,754,435.72; net result -133,753,180.62. All foot. The fund is fed by telecom operators' contributions (own-source); its statements name the ministry as the one it answers to, and it receives no transfer in the finance law, so nothing here is counted twice. Unaudited year-end accounts (audited at least every three years, per ARTEC's 2024 report); md5 matched.
